recentItems.description:
Presenting "Tere Sang (Song)" from the film "Don't By Shy".

Credits:
Song: Tere Sang 
Composed, arranged & produced by: Ram Sampath
Singers: Armaan Malik & Yaashasvii Ddasane
Harmony Singers: Ram Sampath & Dimple Saikia
Lyrics: Ram Sampath & Devansh Vaidya 
Additional Production: Amey Ghule & Bala Murali 
Live Guitars: Amey Ghule 
Bass Programmed by: Jitul Boro 
Music Production Head: Vrashal Chavan
Mix & Mastered by: Amey Wadibhasme at Omgrown Studios, Mumbai. 
Assistant Mix Engineer: Devansh Vaidya. 

Executive Producer: Sona Mohapatra 
Music Supervisor: Vishruti Bindal 
Artist Coordination: Pooja Puliyadi
Music Label: T-Series

Written & directed by Sreeti Mukerji 

Lyrics:-

Palkon pe rakh loon tujhe,
Dil ki yahi hai ab duaa,
Maine toh maana hai tujhe,
Seene mein saanson ki tarah.

Tu jahaan bhi jaaye,
Jaaun tere sang,
Dil ki hai yahi manzoori.

Tere sang har jagah,
Tu mera raasta,
Sang tere main rahoon sadaa.

Tere sang har jagah,
Tu mera raasta,
Sang tere main rahoon sadaa.

Dil ye mera jo keh naa sakaa,
Aankhein meri keh gayin,
Halka saa ehsaas hone lagaa,
Main toh teri ho gayi.

Ye jo nasha hai pehli dafaa,
Dil pe kaaboo naa rahaa.

Aayi jo meri zindagi mein,
Jeena mujhe aa rahaa.

Sapne woh saare jee lenge sang,
Is pal mein naa ho doori.

Tere sang har jagah,
Tu mera raasta,
Sang tere main rahoon sadaa.

Tere sang har jagah,
Tu mera raasta,
Sang tere main rahoon sadaa.

Teri hansi se din ye mehke,
Tu roothe toh naa ho subah,
Jaana naa hai tere binaa kahin,
Tu hi hai mera raasta.

Tere sang har jagah,
Tu mera raasta,
Sang tere main rahoon sadaa.
